name: ReadJoy – Progress Bar with Celebrations
author: farjanaplugin

sections.description:
ReadJoy brings joy to every reading experience! 🎉

Make your readers feel special with a beautiful progress bar, accurate reading time estimation, and when they finish reading – celebrate them with confetti and heartfelt messages!

Unlike other progress bar plugins, ReadJoy doesn’t just track progress – it celebrates your readers, making them feel valued and encouraging them to come back for more.

Perfect for bloggers, news websites, magazines, and any content site that wants to boost engagement and create memorable reading experiences!

🎉 What Makes ReadJoy Special?

ReadJoy is the only WordPress plugin that celebrates your readers when they finish an article!

Celebration System:
* 🎊 “Shukriya!” Popup – Beautiful reward message when reading is complete
* 🎭 Smart Mood Detection – AI analyzes your content and shows appropriate messages (happy for positive content, empathetic for sad stories)
* ✨ Confetti Animation – Delightful visual celebration that makes readers smile
* ⭐ Review Request – Gentle reminder to leave feedback (can be disabled)
* 🌐 Multi-language – Bengali & English support

No other plugin does this! Make your readers feel valued! ❤️

✨ Key Features

Reading Progress Bar:
* 📊 Smooth Real-time Progress Bar – Updates as readers scroll
* 🎨 5 Beautiful Styles – Solid, Gradient, Striped, Animated, Glow
* 🎨 Dynamic Color Support – All styles use your selected color
* 📍 Flexible Positioning – Top or bottom of the page
* 💫 Smooth Animations – Professional and engaging
* 🎯 Glassmorphism Design – Modern blurred background effects

Smart Reading Time Calculator:
* ⏱️ Accurate Time Estimation – Based on Words Per Minute (WPM)
* 📊 Live Progress Percentage – Shows how much is read (e.g., “45% read”)
* 🕐 Estimated Finish Time – When readers will complete the article
* 🔢 Customizable WPM – Adjust for your audience (default: 200)
* 📝 Custom Text Labels – Personalize all messages

Advanced Customization:
* 🎨 Color Picker – Bar, text, background colors
* 📏 Size Controls – Bar thickness, font size, border radius
* 🔤 Typography Options – Font styles and sizes
* 💫 Hover Effects – Interactive animations
* 🎯 Box Shadow – Beautiful depth effects
* ⚙️ Enable/Disable Controls – Turn features on/off as needed

Post Type Support:
* ✅ Blog Posts
* ✅ Pages
* ✅ Custom Post Types
* ✅ BBPress Forums
* ✅ WooCommerce Products
* ✅ Any public post type

🎯 Perfect For

  • Bloggers – Keep readers engaged and reduce bounce rate
  • News Websites – Show article length and reading time
  • Educational Sites – Help students track learning progress
  • Long-form Content – Make reading more enjoyable

  4. Enable celebration popup (or disable if you prefer)
  5. Adjust WPM for your audience
  6. Done! Your readers will love it!

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Search for “ReadJoy” or “Reading Progress”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate”
  5. You’ll see a welcome screen – follow the 3 easy steps!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Visit the welcome screen or go to Settings → ReadJoy

After Activation

  1. Quick Start (3 Steps):

    • Choose your favorite color
    • Select position (top or bottom)
    • You’re done!

  2. Advanced Customization:

    • Visit Settings → ReadJoy
    • Adjust WPM, text labels, and display options
    • Customize colors, styles, and effects
    • Enable/disable celebration popup
    • Configure post types

  3. View Your Work:

    • Create or edit a post
    • See the beautiful progress bar in action!
    • Scroll to the end to see the celebration! 🎉
sections.faq:
Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Yes! ReadJoy is designed to work with any WordPress theme that follows WordPress coding standards. It’s been tested with popular themes like Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, and many more.

Can I customize the colors?

Absolutely! You can customize:
* Progress bar color
* Reading time box background
* Text colors
* Border colors
* And much more!

All 5 bar styles (Solid, Gradient, Striped, Animated, Glow) automatically adapt to your chosen color.

Will it slow down my website?

No! ReadJoy is extremely lightweight and optimized. It adds minimal CSS and JavaScript, with zero impact on your site’s performance. The plugin uses best practices and is optimized for speed.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! The plugin is fully responsive and works perfectly on all screen sizes – smartphones, tablets, and desktops. The design adapts beautifully to any screen.

Can I disable it on certain post types?

Yes! You can choose exactly which post types to display the reading progress on from the settings page. Enable it for posts, pages, custom post types, or any combination you prefer.

Can I disable the celebration popup?

Yes! There’s a checkbox in settings to enable/disable the celebration popup. All other features will continue to work normally even if the popup is disabled.

How is reading time calculated?

Reading time is calculated based on Words Per Minute (WPM). The default is 200 WPM (average adult reading speed), but you can adjust it in settings to match your audience. The plugin also accounts for images (approximately 10 seconds per image).

What is the “Shukriya” celebration popup?

“Shukriya” (শুকরিয়া) means “Thank You” in Bengali/Urdu. It’s a beautiful reward popup that appears when readers finish your article, thanking them with personalized messages and delightful confetti animation! It makes readers feel valued and encourages them to return.

How does mood detection work?

ReadJoy analyzes your content for emotional keywords and context. It then displays appropriate celebration messages:
– Happy/positive content → Cheerful celebration
– Sad/touching content → Empathetic message
– Neutral content → Appreciative thank you

This creates a more personalized and meaningful experience for your readers.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes! The plugin is translation-ready and fully internationalized. It currently has built-in support for English and Bengali, with more languages coming soon. You can also create your own translation using standard WordPress translation tools.

Does it track user data?

No! ReadJoy is 100% privacy-friendly. It doesn’t collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It doesn’t use cookies, connect to external services, or track users. Your readers’ privacy is completely protected.

Can I hide the reading time but keep the progress bar?

Yes! All features can be controlled independently. You can enable/disable:
– Progress bar
– Reading time display
– Progress percentage
– Estimated finish time
– Celebration popup

Mix and match to create your perfect setup!

Is there a pro version?

No! All features are 100% FREE forever. We want to support the WordPress community with all premium features at no cost. There will never be a paid version – this is our commitment! ❤️

How do I get support?

We’re here to help!
* Visit the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org
* Check the documentation on our website
* Contact us through GitHub (TanjinaAkte)

We typically respond within 24 hours!
